LESSON: DRESSING ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.6: Dressing ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Dressing ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. dress and undress appropriately
2. to put on shoes correctly
3. appreciate one’s clothes for self-esteem wearing socks clothes(sweater, jackets, shirts, shoes, shorts, skirts, blouses) about clothes Core-Competences to be developed:

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. dress and undress appropriately
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to dress and undress appropriately. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. to put on shoes correctly
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to to put on shoes correctly. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate one’s clothes for self-esteem wearing socks clothes(sweater, jackets, shirts, shoes, shorts, skirts, blouses) about clothes Core-Competences to be developed:
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate one’s clothes for self-esteem wearing socks clothes(sweater, jackets, shirts, shoes, shorts, skirts, blouses) about clothes Core-Competences to be developed:. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: dress and undress appropriately
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dressing ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Dressing ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. dress and undress appropriately
2. to put on shoes correctly
3. appreciate one’s clothes for self-esteem wearing socks clothes(sweater, jackets, shirts, shoes, shorts, skirts, blouses) about clothes Core-Competences to be developed:

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
